rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: UIDriver is an MCP server that enables AI chat clients to generate rich, interactive user interfaces that open directly in the browser without requiring app installations. The server provides over 40 specialized tools for creating charts, diagrams, visualizations, forms, calendars, and data tables, with generated UIs being fully interactive, editable, and exportable in various formats. Built with security in mind using temporary private URLs that automatically expire, UIDriver transforms AI conversations into dynamic visual experiences by allowing LLMs to create everything from financial candlestick charts and network diagrams to interactive forms and project Gantt charts based on context data or user requirements.
